resources.string: Ringfence mutes your phone at the start of a window and turns sound back on the moment it ends. Nothing is left silent by accident.
Required to change your ringer — it\'s the only permission we ask for.
Runs on a schedule, not in the background
No location, no contacts, no network. Timers only.
If the app is killed mid-window, sound is restored on next launch.
